items.notes: 08 §8, geography as structural barrier: the trial is fine, the flight is not.

body: Ilya Nikolaevich takes his phone away from his ear and puts it in his pocket.
The man from Orlovka is not coming. Everything out of Yekaterinburg is grounded until Thursday.
They will send someone with a camera instead. The camera is already here, on a tripod, pointed at the far goal.

choices.outcome_text: You know where it is for ninety minutes. You play like a man who knows where a camera is.

choices.text: Forget the camera and play the game.
choices.outcome_text: Ilya Nikolaevich says you were the best of them. Nobody in Orlovka watches the tape.

items.notes: 08 §7: the coach who mattered is not lying, he is wrong.

body: The man who asked about you was sacked on Tuesday. It was in the district paper before anyone told the club.
Whoever comes next will want his own list. Yours was on the desk of a man who cleared his desk.

choices.text: Ask who they are bringing in.
choices.outcome_text: Nobody knows yet. Two names go around the changing room and neither of them is real.

choices.text: Say nothing and go to training.
choices.outcome_text: You are first there. It makes no difference and you do it anyway.

items.notes: 03 §7.3: the academy has a relationship and his agent does not.

body: They have taken a boy from an academy two hundred kilometres north. He is nineteen. You have played against him.
He is not better than you. His club and their club have been sending each other players for eleven years.

choices.text: Ask Ruslan whether anything can still be done.
choices.outcome_text: He says he will make a call this week. He says it in the voice he uses for the whole list.
You look him up later. He plays eleven minutes all season.

body: The doctor turns your ankle in his hands twice and writes for a long time.
He says there is a little movement in it that should not be there. He asks if it hurts. It does not hurt.
He writes that down too, and then he writes something else.

choices.text: Tell him it has never stopped you.
choices.outcome_text: He agrees with you and does not change the form.
In the corridor a woman asks if you are the boy for the trial. You say you were.

items.notes: 03 §7.3: the failure he did control still gets a scene of its own.

body: Everything that could have gone your way went your way. The scout came, the money was there, nothing tore.
You were not good enough yet. The man who tells you is kind about it and takes forty seconds.

choices.outcome_text: He says everything, evenly, and means it as encouragement. On the bus you write three of them down.
The bus is at seven. You are early for it by an hour and ten minutes.
